SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BIZ_REF_KEY FROM SAPSR3.ZTMM094 WHERE TRIM(OK_CODE) IS NULL GROUP BY BIZ_REF_KEY
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'DRBW' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,WERKS AS PLANT ,EBELN AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,EBELP AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,MATNR AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,BIZ_REF_KEY AS LEGACY_GR_NO ,WAERS AS CURRENCY_CODE ,BUDAT AS GR_DATE ,MENGE AS GR_QTY ,MEINS AS UNIT_MEASURE ,NETPR AS UNIT_PRICE FROM SAPSR3.ZTMM094 WHERE BIZ_REF_KEY = '$R_RS.BIZ_REF_KEY$' AND TRIM(OK_CODE) IS NULL ORDER BY EBELN, EBELN, EBELP
UPDATE SAPSR3.ZTMM094 SET OK_CODE = 'X' WHERE BIZ_REF_KEY = '$R_RS.BIZ_REF_KEY$' AND TRIM(OK_CODE) IS NULL
